title: Universal Printable Technology Catalogue — Projection and Expansion Contract
principle: Maintain one underlying evidence-bearing catalogue; project it by audience, local horizon, consequence, domain and maturity rather than creating disconnected catalogues.
expansion_rule: New technology is added by decomposing it into existing primitives/interfaces/processes first. Add a new primitive only where decomposition leaves a falsifiable missing function.
outreach_rule: Public/partner material must show readiness/evidence and DIY/safety level alongside benefits. Outreach cannot strengthen the underlying evidence ceiling.

organization_pattern.status: candidate portfolio-delivery pattern, not legal advice or incorporated structure
organization_pattern.contributors: paid/benefit-bearing specialist contributors + bounded volunteer/community/research participation
organization_pattern.network: InterSol/federated delivery partners and local nodes
